title: Countdown and Total
prompt:
Two loops:

1. Write a function `countdown(start)` that logs each number from `start` down to 1 (one per line) using a loop.
2. Write a function `sumUpTo(n)` that RETURNS the sum of all whole numbers from 1 to n (use an accumulator loop, not a hard-coded answer).

Log `sumUpTo(10)` — it should print 55.

tests.name: countdown logs start down to 1
tests.hint: for (let i = start; i >= 1; i--) { console.log(i); }

tests.name: sumUpTo returns the real sum
tests.hint: let total = 0; for (let n = 1; n <= max; n++) { total = total + n; } return total;

tests.name: sumUpTo actually loops
tests.hint: The accumulator pattern needs a loop — no shortcuts like n*(n+1)/2 for this one.
